meta.title: A safe AI learning buddy for kids
meta.description: Educational games and a safe AI buddy that answers children's questions, with parents in full control. Private by design.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.title: The curious buddy your kids can ask anything.
landing.subtitle: Learning games from preschool to 5th grade and a safe AI buddy that answers questions and helps with homework — the right way, for their age. You see everything.

features.title: A buddy, not a search engine
features.text: Your child chooses their mascot and asks anything. Answers are tuned to their age and guide them to think, not to copy.

features.title: Games that grow with them
features.text: Counting, letters, maths, science and English, from preschool to 5th grade.

features.title: Parents see everything
features.text: Every question, every answer, progress and time. Instant alerts if something worries us.

features.title: Safe and private by design
features.text: No ads, no trackers, no child accounts. AI hosted in the EU that never keeps or learns from your child's words.

how.title: Create your parent space
how.text: Just your email. No password to remember.

how.title: Add your children
how.text: A nickname, a school year and a cute avatar. Nothing else.

how.title: Hand over the device
how.text: Add it to the home screen of an iPad or phone: it opens like an app.

landing.safetyTitle: Built for children, with rules that don't bend
safety: Two safety checks on every question and every answer
Sensitive topics are never discussed in depth: the child is invited to talk to you and you get an alert
Personal data like addresses or phone numbers are removed before reaching the AI or being saved
Chats are deleted automatically after 90 days, or whenever you want
landing.trustCta: Read how we protect your family
landing.footer: Made with care in Italy, for children everywhere.

login.title: Parent sign in
login.subtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.
login.sent: We sent a code to {email}. It may take a minute.
login.invalid: That code doesn't look right, or it expired.
login.adultsOnly: This area is for parents and legal guardians only.

onboarding.consentText: This app is used by children, so we ask the person responsible for them to agree to how it works.
onboarding.adult: I am an adult and a parent or legal guardian of the children I will add.
onboarding.privacy: I have read the privacy notice and the information on how AI is used.
onboarding.childConsent: I give consent, on behalf of my children, to the processing of their data as described (nickname, school year, game results, chat messages kept for 90 days and visible to me).
onboarding.aiConsent: I authorise my children, who are under 14, to use the AI buddy (an artificial intelligence system), knowing that I can read every conversation and turn the chat off at any time.
onboarding.pinText: 4 digits that protect your area on your child's device. Don't share it with your children.
onboarding.childrenText: We only need a nickname (not the real full name), the school year and an avatar.
onboarding.doneText: Add the app to the home screen of the device your child uses, then hand it over.

install.title: Add to home screen
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
install.android: On Android: open the browser menu ⋮, then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

kid.mascotIntro: Hi! I'm {mascot}. I'm a computer program that loves questions. Ask me anything!
